title: Tôi có thể gọi điện thoại được không?
englishTitle: Can I make a phone call?
pronunciation: Toi co the goi dien thoai duoc khong
summary: For asking to place a quick call when your own phone, SIM, or data is not working.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: This is a small permission ask, not a tech explanation. Keep the number or contact visible before you borrow a phone.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Ask first, then show the contact, hotel number, or ride driver screen. Do not hand over private messages unless needed.

phrases.vietnamese: Tôi có thể gọi điện thoại được không?
phrases.english: Can I make a phone call?
phrases.pronunciation: Toi co the goi dien thoai duoc khong

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Có thể is can; gọi điện thoại is making a phone call; được không asks if it is okay.

breakdown.vietnamese: Tôi có thể gọi điện thoại được không?
breakdown.english: Can I make a phone call?

sections.title: Useful nearby phrases
sections.body: Wi-Fi and SIM questions are natural follow-ups because the call often starts with a connection problem.

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Good at hotel desks, SIM shops, cafes, tour counters, and reception desks when a quick call would solve the next step.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: If the call is urgent, show the contact name and number. If it is personal, ask whether they can dial while you speak.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: If the call is not the only issue, ask about battery, chargers, charging, data, or eSIM help.
